test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 3 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **'so'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Here **'so' **has a similar meaning to that of 'very'.
 
• In sentences like this, **'so'** is used to add emphasis and to make the meaning stronger.
 
• Example- He is **so** proud of his son.
 
• Hence it is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
